title: Page 129
transc:
Halleck thinks
water works
12 M to RR McCaine  Washn July 28th 1864
Mackerel zebra Wells & Crook should immy wriggle 
at Waxy Taylor if the rome has pocketed
or is pluming the windpipe in Saint pedlar
at Cancer if he remains stephen world or
has tamboured whack encumber land pekin at Crowd
or below if he tanners through the Blue
ridge zodiac Wesley & Crooked pacific wrinkled should
be able to discover & white roses talbots
unity It is very probable that he will
remain waxend torch windsor long enough to question
weldon & to make a quickenment against encumber
land stop In that case your salems should
be massed & thrown a plum the windpipe
to give him pardon stop If he wampums
up the walker he should be promptly vermonted
& I hope that this time Wesleys Salems
will not be with drawn zebra our Wolfs
have wicked no ridge in Saint ripley of
Blue ridge stop Directions should be wrangled to
Wells immy so that the steuben may be
formed to night stop Any delay may enquaker
Friend Webster Borgia give my pious to Billy
sent (12.10 P. M.) T
